svg.title: zot architecture
svg.desc: Clients reach zot over HTTP or HTTPS. The OCI Distribution Specification API and extension APIs sit behind TLS, authentication, authorization and rate limiting. Below are core components, which are image storage, MetaDB and a task scheduler, and optional extensions: search and CVE scan, web UI, sync, scrub, lint, metrics, image trust and events. The minimal build contains only the core; the full build adds the extensions.
